title: Twin Fates
next_chapter_hook: The Demonic Path Commander's proposal plunged Chen Ji into an unprecedented choice—if fate can be fused, can the so-called sacrifice also be completely rewritten?

text.content:
The mark of the writer scorched like a burning rune, slowly taking shape in the deepest part of Chen Ji's soul. The Tianji Record emanated a vicissitude aura spanning ten thousand years, creating some profound resonance with his consciousness—as if he was no longer merely a recorder, but the sword-wielding figure controlling the entire fate chess game.

However, in this very moment, his back suddenly chilled.

The warning came from the Tianji Record Fragment simultaneously—danger, not from Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, but from beyond the Void.

dialogue.content:
"He's here." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a rare solemnity, "The news that you've obtained the writer's authority has already been sensed by that person. Be careful, he is no ordinary enemy."

Before the words even finished, a pitch-black rift suddenly tore open above the ruins.

text.content:
Within the rift, demonic energy churned like a raging sea. A figure slowly walked out from nothingness, surrounded by a mist intertwining crimson and black, each step causing space to tremble.

The Demonic Path Commander.

The face obscured by demonic energy was unclear, but those eyes—black as an abyss, yet burning with eerie blood-colored flames in their depths—were firmly locked onto Chen Ji.

dialogue.content:
On the surface, Chen Ji maintained the terror and panic befitting a废物 disciple, his body slightly trembling as if he would collapse at any moment.

But his divine sense had already quietly extended toward the fifth page of the Tianji Record—he wanted to see clearly what this Demonic Path Commander was all about.

However, in the next moment, his pupils sharply contracted.

text.content:
On the fifth page, two fate trajectories intertwined like vines that had been entangled for billions of years, wrapping around each other, intersecting, even—overlapping. At certain nodes, they completely coincided, as if the same fate projected across different timelines.

More eerily, the color of these two fate lines was identical to the color of Chen Ji's own destiny.

They were each other's reflections. Each other's mirrors.

dialogue.content:
"Interesting." Chen Ji suppressed the tidal waves in his heart, a faint smile tugging at the corner of his lips, his voice unusually clear in the demonic energy-swept ruins, "I thought the Demonic Path Commander would be some green-faced, fang-toothed monster, but turns out you're also human."

He no longer used the废物 tone, but restored that terrifying calmness.

"Or rather—you are not 'you' either?"

text.content:
The Demonic Path Commander stopped. Those eyes burning with blood flames slightly narrowed, as if examining some interesting prey.

"Interesting." His voice was hoarse and deep, as if coming from the Nine Nether Abyss, "You've just been branded with writer's authority, and you dare reveal your true self before me?"

He took a step forward, demonic energy surging violently, the entire ruins trembling under this pressure.

"Or is this—your trump card?"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji did not retreat. He even laughed, his laughter clear and bright, utterly out of place in this demonic energy-filled ruin.

"Trump card?" He shook his head, "Demonic Path Commander, you've traveled thousands of miles tearing through the Void to come here, surely not just to see my trump card?"

He raised his head, directly facing those abyss blood eyes.

"You are also part of the 'sacrifice chess game'—am I right?"

text.content:
The air in the ruins suddenly solidified.

The Demonic Path Commander fell silent. The light in those blood flame eyes flickered slightly, as if reassessing this "废物" before him.

"How did you know?" His voice changed, no longer the domineering pressure, but with a hint of...fatigue?

"The fifth page of the Tianji Record." Chen Ji said calmly, "Our fate lines are completely synchronized."

dialogue.content:
"So what?" The Demonic Path Commander's voice restored its coldness, "What does knowing this change? Our fates are synchronized, which means either you die or I die—there has only ever been one person who can walk out of this game."

Chen Ji, however, shook his head.

"No. The Tianji Record shows 'possibilities,' not 'certainties.'" A calculating light gleamed in the depths of his eyes, "Moreover, I never believe fate has only one ending."

choice.prompt: The truth of fate surfaces—the Demonic Path Commander is not a mere enemy, but another chess piece alongside Chen Ji in the sacrifice chess game. Facing this destiny-knowing nemesis, Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: No matter how fate arranges things, Chen Ji never bows his head to anyone. What of the Demonic Path Commander? Since victory and defeat are destined to be decided, better to strike first before he fully reveals his strength.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 Heavenly Fate Value to activate Tianji Record warning
choices.visible_reward: Gain first-mover advantage, suppress opponent in momentum
choices.risk_hint: The opponent tore through the Void to arrive, strength unfathomable, direct confrontation carries extremely high risk

text.content:
Chen Ji's momentum suddenly changed. The cowardice befitting a废物 disciple vanished without a trace, replaced by a chilling edge that struck fear into the heart.

"Confront?" He chuckled, "Did you think I was discussing this with you?"

The Tianji Record materialized in his palm, the writer's authority beginning to flow.

"If fate demands my death, I will rewrite fate. If fate demands your demise—" He raised his head, his gaze sharp as a blade, "Then I will send you on your way first."

choices.description: The enemy of my enemy is my friend. The Demonic Path Commander is clearly also trapped by the sacrifice chess game. Since their fate trajectories are synchronized, it means they face the same higher-level threat. Joining forces might be the key to breaking the局面.
choices.visible_cost: Expose partial trump cards to show sincerity
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence: the complete truth of the sacrifice chess game
choices.risk_hint: Cooperating with the Demonic Path is like walking on thin ice, with the constant risk of being betrayed

text.content:
Chen Ji put away all his edge, his tone calm as if discussing the weather.

"You tore through the Void to come here, shouldn't be just to kill me, right?" He slowly spoke, "The sacrifice chess game—you know better than I what that is. Both you and I are merely chess pieces; the true chess player still lurks behind the scenes."

He stared directly into those abyss blood eyes.

"So I give you a suggestion: either you kill me now, or—we sit down and talk."

choices.description: Synchronized fate trajectories mean two people's powers can complement each other. Rather than being toyed with by fate, better to take the initiative—devour the other's Heavenly Fate, fill the gaps in the Tianji Record, and completely break the chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 points of Heavenly Fate to activate the Devouring Formation
choices.visible_reward: Obtain all of the Demonic Path Commander's Heavenly Fate, greatly improve the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The devouring process is extremely dangerous; failure will result in Heavenly Fate backlash

text.content:
A sinister curve appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. His right hand subtly formed a seal, and the fifth page of the Tianji Record began to spin wildly at an unnoticeable angle.

"Devour?" The Demonic Path Commander seemed to sense something, his blood-flame twin pupils suddenly surging.

"Since neither of us can escape the sacrificial chess game—" Chen Ji's voice was low and dangerous, "—then let me devour this entire game."

The devouring formation suddenly took shape, shrouding both of them within.

The Demonic Path Commander fell silent for a moment, then let out a low, ringing laughter. Within the laughter carried an indescribable meaning—was it mockery, or relief?

"Interesting. For ten thousand years, you are the first to dare speak of 'rewriting fate' before me."

He slowly raised his hand, demonic energy condensing into a pitch-black token within his palm.

"Since you know about fate synchronization, you should also understand—regardless of which of us dies, the survivor won't live long either."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's eyes slightly narrowed.

This intelligence—he truly didn't know it.

The Tianji Record only displayed the surface of fate synchronization, never revealing the cost behind synchronization.

"So this is your trump card?" he quickly regained his composure, "threatening me with shared life and death?"

The Demonic Path Commander shook his head, tossing that token toward Chen Ji.

"No. This is my sincerity."

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't catch it, letting the token float in mid-air.

"The truth of the sacrificial chess game is far more terrifying than you can imagine." The Demonic Path Commander's voice turned heavy, "You think the Heavenly Eye is the final BOSS? Wrong. It's merely a chess piece of a higher existence."

He stepped forward, demonic energy colliding with Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate power in the air, producing an ear-piercing hiss.

"And we—the so-called twins of fate—are merely sacrificial offerings in this ritual."

dialogue.content:
"Sacrificial offerings?" Chen Ji's voice turned ice-cold.

He slowly raised his head, those eyes now stripped of any pretense, containing only pure chill.

"I, Chen Ji, am never a sacrificial offering."

The Tianji Record slowly unfolded behind him, the Record Keeper's authority erupting in a brilliant flash of light.

"No matter who arranged this chess game—I will personally overturn this board."

text.content:
A gleam flickered in the Demonic Path Commander's blood-flame twin pupils—was it recognition, or wariness?

"That's why I came." he said, "Because only you can see the possibility of overturning the board."

He stepped forward once more. This time, the demonic energy收敛, that terrifying aura suddenly vanished. Replacing it was an unusual... calm.

"I have a third proposal."

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander proposed a third possibility—this would fundamentally change Chen Ji's understanding of fate.

choices.description: Since fate has already synchronized, rather than mutual suspicion, why not proactively fuse—the Heavenly Fate of two people merging as one, perhaps capable of transcending the sacrificial chess game's rule limitations.
choices.visible_cost: Surrender partial independent consciousness, bind with the Demonic Path Commander
choices.visible_reward: Obtain全新的能力 from fate fusion, greatly improve the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The fusion process is irreversible; once begun, there is no turning back

dialogue.content:
The Demonic Path Commander slowly spoke: "Fate fusion—not devouring, not cooperation, but truly becoming one. You and I were originally one entity with two forms, forcibly separated and turned into opposing chess pieces."

He raised his hand, and a light pattern identical to Chen Ji's Tianji Record appeared in his palm.

"The sacrificial chess game wants us to slaughter each other, but if we choose fusion—the chess game itself will collapse due to rule conflicts."

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent.

This proposal... was far beyond his expectations.

He originally thought the Demonic Path Commander was an enemy, never expecting the other party was also a chess piece. He originally thought fate synchronization meant life or death for one, never expecting there was another path—fusion.

But fusion... would mean losing part of oneself.

For the all-calculating Chen Ji, this was more unbearable than death.

dialogue.content:
"Let me think." Chen Ji's voice was very soft.

The Demonic Path Commander nodded, as if having anticipated his reaction long ago.

"You have three days." he said, "In three days, regardless of your answer, I will give you a meeting gift—news about your sister."

Chen Ji's eyes suddenly narrowed.

"How do you know—"

"Fate synchronization." The Demonic Path Commander turned, demonic energy beginning to surge again, "Your weakness is also my weakness."

text.content:
As his words fell, the Demonic Path Commander's figure began to dissolve.

But before completely vanishing, his voice rang out once more—this time, carrying an imperceptible warmth.

"Chen Ji... no, I should call you 'the other half of myself.'"

"This sacrificial ritual has been ongoing for countless epochs. Countless versions of us have died within this chess game."

"It's time to end it."

The spatial rift slowly closed, and the ruins returned to deathly silence.

Chen Ji stood alone in the ruins, the Record Keeper's mark burning faintly within his divine soul.

His mind echoed with the Demonic Path Commander's words.

Countless epochs. Countless "thems." All died within this sacrificial game.

And was he the nth one?

On the Tianji Record's fifth page, those two fate lines that had been intertwined for who knows how many years were now trembling slightly—as if waiting for an answer.

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed within Chen Ji's mind.

"You heard." he said, "Fate fusion... this is a possibility I didn't anticipate either."

"You knew about the sacrificial chess game long ago?" Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold.

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment: "What I know is far more than you imagine. But some things must be chosen by yourself."

"Just like you chose to let me walk step by step to this point?" Chen Ji countered.

The remnant soul gave no answer.

text.content:
The wind in the ruins stirred dust, Chen Ji's garments rustling loudly.

His gaze fell upon the Tianji Record in his hands—the fifth page, where those two fate lines still slowly intertwined.

Fusion...

This meant he would no longer be the sole Record Keeper, no longer the all-calculating manipulator. He would share fate, even share consciousness, with a demonic cultivator.

But if he didn't do this—

"Sister..." he murmured, "what would you choose?"

No one could answer him.

Chen Nian's whereabouts, the truth of the sacrificial chess game, the possibility of fate fusion—all these mysteries intertwined, like those two fate lines on the Tianji Record's fifth page.

And he himself was merely a chess piece within this game of cosmic proportions.

But chess pieces... can also overturn the board.

He secured the Tianji Record and turned to leave the ruins. The three-day deadline had already begun its countdown.
